detailed_descriptions.en: "I could watch this forever." Right beside you at your desk, Laid-Back Camp is there. Laid-Back Camp All -in -one!! Chill Time is a game that lets you spend your work or study time alongside Rin, Nadeshiko, and the others as you watch them camp. Stoking the campfire, peering into the cooking pot, or lying down to gaze at the sky— whenever you glance over, you’ll see them passing the time in their own unique ways. The time you spend alone at your desk becomes time spent together with them. The time spent with the Laid-Back Camp (Yuru Camp△) crew becomes a record of your day. Time accumulates in your diary each time you cycle between work and breaks using the Pomodoro timer. List your tasks in the To-Do section and check them off as you complete them. You can look back at your daily progress on the calendar at any time. Create your own unique campsite with over 1,000 types of gear and outfit options. Freely dress up Nadeshiko, Rin, Chiaki, Aoi, and Ena in everything from their familiar outfits to original costumes. Place tents, gear, and food wherever you like, crafting a scenic view you can gaze at all day long. Compose your own soundscape to match your mood. Select background music and layer ambient sounds—such as a campfire, rain, a river, insects, wind, or the ocean—at your preferred balance. A change in the sounds around you can transform the way you spend your time, even while sitting at the same desk. The scenery keeps moving even while you pause your work. The camera shifts to different spots around the campsite every few seconds. You can leave it running in the background while you work. Keep it in the corner of your desktop and watch it anytime. Display it in a small window set to "always on top" so it doesn't interfere with other tasks. You can check the remaining timer simply by glancing over at it. Voiced by the same cast as the anime. Rin, Nadeshiko, and the others are voiced by the same cast as in the anime version. ■ Steam Edition Bonus Get all six campsites available at the start of the game! - Lake Motosu Campsite - Spring - Nadeshiko's Home Garden - Eastwood Auto Campsite - Lake Shibire Campsite - Winter - Jinba Kogen Mountain Campground - Forest Campsite * Claim your bonus from the Gift Box in game. * Campsites you already own will not be granted.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
"I could watch this forever."

Right beside you at your desk, Laid-Back Camp is there.

Laid-Back Camp All -in -one!! Chill Time is a game that lets you spend your work or study time alongside Rin, Nadeshiko, and the others as you watch them camp.

Stoking the campfire, peering into the cooking pot, or lying down to gaze at the sky—

whenever you glance over, you’ll see them passing the time in their own unique ways.

The time you spend alone at your desk becomes time spent together with them.

The time spent with the Laid-Back Camp (Yuru Camp△) crew becomes a record of your day.

Time accumulates in your diary each time you cycle between work and breaks using the Pomodoro timer.

List your tasks in the To-Do section and check them off as you complete them.

You can look back at your daily progress on the calendar at any time.

Create your own unique campsite with over 1,000 types of gear and outfit options.

Freely dress up Nadeshiko, Rin, Chiaki, Aoi, and Ena in everything from their familiar outfits to original costumes.

Place tents, gear, and food wherever you like, crafting a scenic view you can gaze at all day long.

Compose your own soundscape to match your mood.

Select background music and layer ambient sounds—such as a campfire, rain, a river, insects, wind, or the ocean—at your preferred balance.

A change in the sounds around you can transform the way you spend your time, even while sitting at the same desk.

The scenery keeps moving even while you pause your work.

The camera shifts to different spots around the campsite every few seconds.

You can leave it running in the background while you work.

Keep it in the corner of your desktop and watch it anytime.

Display it in a small window set to "always on top" so it doesn't interfere with other tasks.

You can check the remaining timer simply by glancing over at it.

Voiced by the same cast as the anime.

Rin, Nadeshiko, and the others are voiced by the same cast as in the anime version.

■ Steam Edition Bonus

Get all six campsites available at the start of the game!

- Lake Motosu Campsite - Spring
- Nadeshiko's Home Garden
- Eastwood Auto Campsite
- Lake Shibire Campsite - Winter
- Jinba Kogen Mountain Campground
- Forest Campsite

* Claim your bonus from the Gift Box in game.
* Campsites you already own will not be granted.
